name: Medallia
oneLiner: Enterprise experience management platform that collects customer and employee feedback across surveys, reviews, contact-center conversations and digital channels, and uses AI to find themes and route action to front-line teams.
bestFor: Large, multi-location restaurant and hospitality brands with CX teams that need enterprise-grade feedback analytics across locations and channels; too heavy for independents.

updates.text: A lender group led by Blackstone, Apollo and FS KKR took ownership from Thoma Bravo in a debt-for-equity recapitalization, investing $150 million of new capital; Medallia said it keeps its $500 million AI investment commitment.
Unveiled its innovation agenda at Experience '26, including AI-driven topic modeling and action planning embedded in front-line workflows.
H2 2026 release expanded multilingual AI analysis, added self-service survey distribution and previewed agentic automation.

features: Omnichannel feedback collection: web, email, SMS, QR code, in-app and receipt surveys
Review and social listening alongside solicited feedback
AI text analytics that detect themes, sentiment and urgent issues
Role-based dashboards that compare locations, regions and brands
Closed-loop alerts and case management for front-line follow-up
AI summaries and action planning for front-line managers (Frontline-Ready AI)

pricing.text: Custom enterprise pricing; Medallia does not publish prices.

notes: OWNERSHIP CHANGE: Thoma Bravo (owner since its ~$6.4B take-private in 2021) handed Medallia to its lenders in June 2026 (Bloomberg Law: https://news.bloomberglaw.com/bankruptcy-law/blackstone-led-creditors-take-over-ailing-software-firm-medallia). The product continues to be sold and developed. The Noodles & Company story dates from 2020; no newer named restaurant customer was found within budget. Medallia has a restaurants and food service offering (https://getready.medallia.com/?p=4640). Frontline-Ready AI went GA in July 2026 per trade coverage (not confirmed on Medallia's own site). No unverifiable stats in the current review to drop.
